lines.text: Calf Two ate. Calf One is sulking. It is going fine.
They went back. The sentinel dropped its head. I did not cry. I have a cold.
The herd is hurt. The calves are all I have kept. It is not a comfort.
The road was rebuilt. The calves can walk home. I was avoiding the thought.
Somebody scared the herd. I can tell. The calves flinch at your boots.
